name.full: NLSQL AI Employee: your AI assistant in Microsoft Teams

description.short: Your AI assistant for email, calendar, files and scheduled tasks in Teams.
description.full: NLSQL AI Employee is an AI assistant in Microsoft Teams that runs in your own AWS account, with Claude on Amazon Bedrock. Sign in to Microsoft 365 and it works with your mail, calendar and OneDrive files. It runs scheduled tasks, sends a daily morning briefing, and can watch for important email and upcoming meetings. Send it a file in a personal chat to ask questions about that file. With the optional Gemini features it can also browse the web for you, in a live browser you can watch and take over, and read images.
